theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios are annual costs that funds charge for management and operations, directly impacting your net returns over time.
caption: Every rupee saved on costs can compound into significant wealth over decades. Know what you're paying for before investing. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestmentCosts #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding
